title: pinnlab: A Modular PyTorch Framework for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
description:
pinnlab is a modular PyTorch framework for solving forward and inverse partial differential equation (PDE) problems with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), in which the governing equations are embedded directly in the training loss via automatic differentiation.

The library provides:

  • Solvers — continuous-time collocation PINNs and discrete-time Runge–Kutta PINNs, with reference implementations for the viscous Burgers equation, 2-D incompressible Navier–Stokes, Allen–Cahn, and the nonlinear Schrödinger equation, plus a generic residual framework for user-defined PDEs.
  • Validated accuracy — 1-D heat and wave solvers carrying their closed-form solutions, and an exact Cole–Hopf solution for viscous Burgers, so a trained network is scored by a relative L2 error against the truth rather than assessed from a plot.
  • Architectures — MLP baselines together with Fourier-feature, multi-scale, attention, wavelet, hierarchical, Bayesian, and ensemble network variants.
  • Training — two-stage Adam → L-BFGS optimisation, adaptive loss weighting and gradient balancing, curriculum and multi-fidelity schemes, meta-learning, adversarial training, and memory-efficient training via gradient checkpointing and mixed precision.
  • Sampling — Latin hypercube and low-discrepancy collocation sampling, gradient-based importance sampling, and active-learning acquisition strategies.
  • Uncertainty quantification and inverse problems — learnable PDE coefficients, deep ensembles, Monte-Carlo dropout, Bayesian PINNs, and Gaussian-process-prior prediction.
  • Transfer learning — pre-training, fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and domain adaptation pipelines.
  • Scaling and deployment — data-parallel distributed training with gradient compression, computation caching, performance profiling, and REST/gRPC model serving with container and cloud deployment recipes.
  • Analysis — publication-quality visualisation, error and convergence analysis, and PDE-residual diagnostics.

The package ships with runnable example scripts, executed tutorial notebooks, Sphinx documentation, and a unit, integration, and benchmark test suite.
